messages.author: 69b888755f73d592
messages.subject: Part 5 error
parts:
Hello,

I have been running the GGIR script for a while and it has been working great. As I tried running it with a few new GENE Activ files I received the following error message in Part 5:

Errors and warnings for MSK_CON_FIELD_151__059865_2021-08-27 08-37-59.bin.RData$message
[1] "subscript out of bounds"

$call
`[<-`(`*tmp*`, di, fi:(fi + 2), value = c(ID, fnames.ms3[i],
    wi))

All the other parts work well, but Part 5 wont compute. Is anyone familiar with this error message?

messages.author: 017566be30afa7f3
messages.subject: Re: [GGIR] Part 5 error
parts:
Hi Hans,

This looks like an error that we had a couple of years ago, which I thought I fixed.

Which version of GGIR are you using?
Did you process all data with the same version of GGIR and with the same version of your script?

Can you see in the part 2 report, whether there are recordings with zero wear time or close to zero recording duration What happens, if you remove those from the meta/ms3.out and meta/ms4.out folder then try to process GGIR part 5 again (mode=5)?

Are you able to reproduce the error if you only process your new GENEActiv data with a new output folder?

Best,
Vincent


Dr. Vincent van Hees | Independent consultant | https://accelting.com/
